question: Choose the correct **one-word substitute** for: 'Excessive self-importance or over-confidence.'
solution:
The correct answer is: **Arrogance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The word **"Arrogance"** refers to an attitude of excessive self-importance, over-confidence, or a sense of superiority. (अहंकार)

 

 
• **Example: **His arrogance made it difficult for others to work with him, as he always dismissed their ideas.

 

 

 
• **"Excessive self-importance or over-confidence"** is the definition of arrogance. People with arrogance often underestimate others' capabilities. (अहंकार)

 

 
• **Example: **The manager's arrogance led to a lack of communication in the team.

 

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Arrogance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Prudence** (सावधानी): The quality of being cautious and wise in practical affairs.

 

 
• **Example:** His prudence in financial matters saved the company from bankruptcy.

 

 

 
• **Humility** (विनम्रता): The quality of being humble and not considering oneself superior to others.

 

 
• **Example: **Despite his success, he always treated everyone with humility.

 

 

 
• **Modesty** (शालीनता): The quality of being unassuming or moderate in one's abilities or achievements.

 

 
• **Example:** Her modesty was evident in how she spoke about her achievements.
